FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the ideal class to start SAT prep?

Class 10 or 11 is ideal. Starting in Class 10 gives you time for two or three SAT attempts before your Class 12 application cycle. Class 11 students can still achieve strong scores by end of summer with focused preparation.

How long does it take to see a significant SAT score improvement?

With dedicated preparation, most students see a 100–200 point improvement over 8–12 weeks of structured coaching. Our summer programme is designed to deliver measurable results within one season.

What exactly is 'profile building' and why does it matter?

Top universities globally evaluate you holistically — your activities, leadership, research, and community impact matter as much as grades. Profile building means identifying and developing meaningful extracurriculars and documenting them strategically for your application.

Do I need to have activities already, or can I start from scratch?

You can start from scratch. Many students in Class 10–11 haven't developed a strong profile yet — that's exactly what this programme addresses. We help you identify genuine interests and create meaningful activities in the time available.

Which Indian colleges accept SAT scores?

Many top Indian universities accept SAT scores, including BITS Pilani (all campuses), Ashoka University, OP Jindal Global University, Shiv Nadar University, Plaksha University, SRM University (AP), and Manipal Academy of Higher Education. SAT opens doors to both Indian and global universities.

Does EduAbroad help with Common App and UCAS applications?

Yes. Once your profile and essays are ready, our counsellors guide you through every step of the Common Application (for US universities) and UCAS (for UK universities), including selecting schools, writing supplementals, and meeting all deadlines.

How is EduAbroad's SAT coaching different from other institutes?

EduAbroad uniquely combines score-focused SAT coaching with genuine application mentorship — not just test prep in isolation. Our faculty are trained under Cambridge's international teaching framework, ensuring high academic standards. Every student gets personalised attention and an adaptive study plan tailored to their target score and university list.

Can I book a free one-on-one counselling session?

Absolutely. Call +91 90444 42989 or fill the form above to schedule your free 30-minute session with our counsellors.
